question: Chemical formula of magnesium oxide is __ __ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**MgO**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Magnesium oxide also called magnesia, is an alkaline earth metal oxide.
 
• It is typically produced by calcining certain minerals that are found in nature.
 
• It is solid and can withstand high temperatures both physically and chemically.
 
• Magnesium oxide is composed of the ions Mg2+ and O2-, which are joined together by an ionic bond.
 
• MgO is used as the magnesium oxide chemical formula.
 
• Magnesium is a metal and metals react with oxygen to form metallic oxides.
